'''Wam Lufba''', nicknamed "'''Blam'''," was a freelance vermin exterminator who resided on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. A [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzum]] native of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor's]] [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]], the diminutive Lufba spent his younger days serving as a spotter for [[Rugger/Legends|rugger]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] parties. Barred from becoming a legitimate hunter because of his size, Lufba actually possessed great natural accuracy with the Yuzzumi [[Spear/Legends|spear]], but was never exploited by his colleagues. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]], Lufba and a group of his fellow Yuzzum were captured by a [[Unidentified poacher|poacher]] and taken to Tatooine. There, the poacher intended to give the Yuzzum to the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

Jabba was insulted by the offer, and threw the poacher and his quarry into his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace's]] [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]] pit. While the other Yuzzum and the poacher were devoured by the beast instantly, Lufba picked up an old [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] [[84-U hunting rifle]] that had fallen into the pit, and quickly dispatched three of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Lord/Legends|lord's]] guards. Impressed, one of Jabba's employees, [[Pote Snitkin/Legends|Pote Snitkin]], retrieved Lufba from the pit, and installed the Yuzzum as his henchman. Lufba would serve Snitkin on various [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] runs, and was essentially freed in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] when Snitkin, Jabba, and most of the Hutt's other associates [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|destruction]] of the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']]. After a brief tour of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] with fellow Yuzzum [[Joh Yowza/Legends|Joh Yowza]], Lufba settled down and established his extermination business on Tatooine.

==Biography==
===Spotter===
[[File:Endor matte.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Wam Lufba hunted on his homeworld, the moon Endor (pictured).]]
Wam Lufba [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Short in size, he was derided by his fellow [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzums]] and was not allowed to utilize the Yuzzumi [[Spear/Legends|spear]] during [[Rugger/Legends|rugger]] hunts. He was, however, given permission to accompany the [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] groups in their expeditions, and would work as a spotter. He pinpointed the small, fluffy ruggers on the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] savanna floors, but although he claimed to possess great accuracy with the Yuzzumi spear, he did not participate in the actual hunting.<ref name="db" />

===Capture and employment===
On one expedition,<ref name="db" /> several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|265|Lufba, Wam "Blam"}} establishes that Lufba was kidnapped "several years before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]," which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes to have occurred in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Lufba and four other members of his tribe were captured and rendered unconscious. Upon waking, they found themselves inside the cargo hold of a [[Unidentified poacher|poacher's]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. They soon arrived on the arid world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where the poacher took his quarry to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. Lufba and his fellow Yuzzum were placed before the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], as part of the poacher's efforts to pay off his debts to the Hutt. Jabba was insulted by the offer and threw the Yuzzum and the poacher into his [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]] pit.<ref name="db" />

[[File:PoteSnitkin-RotJAVA.png|thumb|left|250px|Pote Snitkin (pictured) asked Jabba to spare Wam Lufba's life]]
While the poacher and the other Yuzzum were devoured by the rancor, a panicking Lufba found a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] [[84-U hunting rifle]] that had fallen into the pit, ran into the beast's holding pen, and killed three of Jabba's guards with great accuracy. Before the rancor could round on him, [[Pote Snitkin/Legends|Pote Snitkin]], a [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] gunrunner in the Hutt's employ, retrieved Lufba. Snitkin then pleaded with Jabba, asking him to spare Lufba's life so the diminutive Yuzzum could aid him in his line of work. The Hutt agreed, placing Lufba in Snitkin's care.<ref name="db" />

Lufba decided to hold on to the 84-U that had saved his life, and he was rarely seen without it. He soon earned the nickname "Blam" from Snitkin, who consistently took the Yuzzum with him on [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] runs. Whenever he was at Jabba's Palace, Lufba would hunt rodents in the dungeons, or observe [[Hermi Odle/Legends|Hermi Odle]], Snitkin's primary competitor.<ref name="db" /> He also kept an [[Eye/Legends|eye]] on any of the strange new arrivals at the palace.<ref name="CE" /> Lufba came to be seen as Snitkin's henchman, and Odle, in response to the Yuzzum's [[Spy/Legends|spying]], had the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Yoxgit/Legends|Yoxgit]] observe the Skrilling and his associate in turn.<ref name="dby">{{DB|character|yoxgit|Yoxgit}}</ref> Another Yuzzum, [[Joh Yowza/Legends|Joh Yowza]], eventually arrived at the palace as well, to Lufba's delight. Yowza, a member of the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]], frequently conversed with Lufba in between performances,<ref name="db" /> with the two eventually becoming friends.<ref name="CE" />

===Exterminator===
[[File:DustBunnyWithAGun-ROTJ.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Lufba in Jabba's Palace]]
In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Lufba was present in Jabba's throne room when [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], disguised as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], brought the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] before Jabba. The act was part of a ruse to free [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was a captive of the crime [[Lord/Legends|lord]]. At one stage in Organa and Jabba's banter, the disguised Princess produced a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], threatening the crime lord and, by extension, putting the lives of everyone in the room, including Lufba's, at risk. The Hutt foiled their plans, however, and sentenced Solo, Chewbacca, Organa, and their friend [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to be executed at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="rotj">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Lufba chose not to go to the execution, since he sympathized with Skywalker, who had recently killed Jabba's rancor.<ref name="db" />

News of what had happened at the Pit soon reached Lufba:<ref name="db" /> Jabba was dead,<ref name="rotj" /> and Snitkin along with him,<ref name="db" /> while the captives had escaped.<ref name="rotj" /> The Yuzzum realized that he was now free to do whatever he pleased, and left Jabba's Palace. He accompanied Yowza on a tour of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] before returning to Tatooine and establishing himself as an exterminator of [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] and other vermin.<ref name="db" />

==Personality and traits==
Wam Lufba was a persistent Yuzzum, highly skilled in the field of weapon accuracy. He insisted to his peers that he was adept in the use of a Yuzzumi spear, but was judged by his size rather than any real demonstration. These peers were later indirectly proven wrong when Lufba's skill with weaponry saved his life in the rancor pit of Jabba's Palace. He maintained a degree of loyalty to Snitkin<ref name="db" /> and was even perceived as his henchman by others.<ref name="dby" /> Lufba had compassion for those who had suffered ordeals similar to his own and was happy in the company of other members of his [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="db" /> becoming friends with Yuzzum Joh Yowza.<ref name="CE" /> Lufba had matted<ref name="CE" /> [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and yellow eyes<ref name="db" /> and stood 1.4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="CE" />

==Equipment==
Lufba wore no clothing other than a pair of forest [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Yuzzum-CGSWG.png|thumb|right|250px|A puppet of Lufba was inserted into the wall of the Jabba's Palace set.]]
The character of Wam Lufba first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], as a background character seen fleetingly.<ref name="rotj" /> Inspired by the early concept art of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> artists [[Judy Elkins]] and [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] created a prototype maquette of the character.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> During filming of the Jabba's Palace scenes at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[January 25]], and [[February 2]], [[1982]],<ref name="MakingOf" /> Lufba was a puppet that was inserted into the wall of the palace set when used.<ref name="Creatures">''[[Classic Creatures: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> 

Lufba was given identification and a backstory by [[Tim Veekhoven]], writing as "Sompeetalay," through the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]]"<ref name="db" /> Veekhoven derived the name "Wam" from the [[Wikipedia:British|British]] [[Wikipedia:Pop music|pop band]] [[Wikipedia:Wham!|Wham!]], but had originally written the character's nickname as "Blast" instead of "Blam," to which it was changed in the editorial process.<ref name="blog">{{Blog|teekay-421|13|They were the chosen ones}}</ref> The finalized entry was published on the website on [[April 17]], [[2006]].<ref name="What'sTheStory?">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20060417.html|text=What's the Story, Round 5}}</ref>
